Small-cap financials (ABDA, YULE, BEKS, LPGI) are seeing speculative retail inflows, creating volatility that institutional investors should exploit via selective entry, not blanket exposure.

The sector's flat aggregate masks a bifurcated tape: Indonesian names are outperforming US peers, yet the NORMAL signal argues against chasing broad beta. Rotate into high-momentum insurers and niche lenders, and trim laggards like BTPS if they fail to hold gains.

Watch for confirmation above the +1.36% aggregate level; if IDX holds, add exposure to port operators like KPIG on tariff-reform tailwinds.
